policy.interComponentRelocation: teleport; exclude relocation and stabilization frames from timing

limitations: The route measures deterministic camera traversal, not first-person controller physics.
Seven exported rooms are disconnected from the authored start at this capsule size; independent subroutes do not imply a walkable connection.
Unassigned disconnected floor slivers and isolated pockets smaller than 0.96 square meters are excluded, not assumed accessible.
Walkability is sampled at 0.2 meters; every movement segment is rechecked against exact collision triangles at intervals no larger than 0.05 meters.
The decorative Book.glb instances at world Y=75 are outside the ground-floor capsule and do not affect route validation.
